Team — forwarding Globex's appendix. They want a consolidated package by Tue COB. Draft proposal below (please comment inline):

Draft answers (for discussion)
- TAM coverage: 24x7 for Dedicated/Private (global follow-the-sun with regional handover); 9x5 PST for standard hosted customers.  
- On-call rotation: Primary TAM (customer-assigned) + escalation to TAM Lead (regional) -> Platform Ops -> Engineering Incident Lead. Each handover has an SLA for acknowledgement.
- SLAs: 
  * Sev1 (production outage / data safety): acknowledge within 15 min; follow-up every 30 min until mitigation.
  * Sev2 (major feature degradation): acknowledge within 1 hour; updates every 2 hours.
  * Sev3 (minor): acknowledge within 4 business hours; daily updates.
- Incident comms template: initial notification (within SLA), hourly summary (Sev1), post-mortem within 72 hours for Sev1.
- Handover evidence: runbook extract + tam_schedule.xlsx showing rotation and escalation contacts.

Please review and add specifics: who is the "Engineering Incident Lead" on our side for Sev1? Karthik - can you confirm escalation target (name/email) and any change windows constraints? Marissa - please attach the customer-facing incident template and comment on PM/CS involvement for renewals/credits. Neha - any compliance evidence to include (SOC2 artifact pointers)?

Thanks — Vivek
